property_summary: Rule: Only the designated DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT can successfully call setL1BlockValues (so number changes only when msg.sender == DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT); the mutant also allows address(this) (self-calls) so a self-call can change number — violating the rule for some inputs where the contract calls itself.
change_summary: Change the onlyDepositor check to allow either the depositor account or the current owner (msg.sender) — here allowing any sender equal to address(this) (self-call) as well, effectively weakening the check when calls originate from the contract itself.
